Evaluation
Trade Futures in a simulated environment, hit your Profit Target, and stay within the Trading Objectives. There's no time limit. Prove your discipline in Evaluation to move on to your Sim-Funded Account to access payouts.
Pick Your Account
Choose Pro or Growth and a size from $50K to $150K. A bigger size means a bigger target and higher limits.
Start Your Evaluation
Hit the Profit Target
Reach your target while respecting the risk rules:
Stay within your Max Drawdown. Pro accounts also have a Hard Daily Loss Limit.
Consistency Rule: your best day counts for max 50% of total profit on Pro, 40% on Growth.
Progress at Your Own Pace
To pass the Evaluation, you need to meet the Trading Objectives, but there's no time limit to do it. You pay one monthly subscription, and if you need to start over, you can reset your Evaluation for a reduced fee.
See Trading Objectives
Sim-Funded Account
Successfully pass the Evaluation and you're upgraded to a Sim-Funded Account. Same simulated environment, but now you earn real payouts. No targets, no consistency rule. Just trade within the risk limits.
Trade Within the Risk Limits
No Profit Target and no Consistency Rule. Your Max Drawdown still applies. Growth gets a softer Daily Loss Limit, Pro keeps a hard one.
Withdraw Your Profits
Earn real payouts based on your consistent performance.
Hit 5 qualifying days on Pro, 4 on Growth, each above a minimum daily profit.
Keep 90% of the simulated profits you generate.
Request a payout every 5 days on Pro, every 4 on Growth, up to your payout cap.
See all rules applicable to payouts
Live Funded Account
Reach the top step. Move to a Live Funded Account backed by FTMO capital and reach daily payouts. The only Trading Objective left is your Max Drawdown.
Not automatic: the Live Funded Account is offered by invitation only, after FTMO validates your Sim-Funded trading.
Clear the One-Time Buffer
Before your first payout you clear a one-time buffer on your account. Then it's gone for good.
Daily Payouts
Once your buffer is cleared, you can request a payout daily.
Withdraw your profit above the buffer daily, with no payout cap.

How to start?

Before you decide to start a 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account, we want to make sure that you understand how the process works and what is expected of you.

Choosing your product

After you sign up at https://trader.ftmo.com/, you can start by choosing one of our three products: 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account. The products differ in their Trading Objectives, pricing, and conditions. This allows you to select the structure that best matches your trading style and experience.

To help you get familiar with these products, we offer a Free Trial, a simplified version of these accounts. You can see more information about our Free Trial via the attached link. You may repeat the Free Trial as many times as you need to feel well prepared.

Setting up your account

Once you are ready, you can configure your account by selecting your product and account size. Key parameters:

Our accounts can be denominated in USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, CZK, CAD or AUD. The chosen account currency does not determine the currency in which we send you a reward.
Accounts are paid for with a one-time fee; no further fees are charged.
Available trading platforms are MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader or TradingView.
Important note

Please note that it is not possible to obtain an FTMO Account based on any external trading track record. To qualify for a Reward, you must successfully meet the Trading Objectives and applicable eligibility requirements of the selected account.

I have successfully passed, what to do now?

This article outlines the steps required to pass the evaluation phases of the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and 2-Step FTMO Challenge. FTMO Instant Account is excluded from this FAQ due to the nature of the product.

1-Step FTMO Challenge

The 1-Step FTMO Challenge does not include a Verification phase. After you successfully pass all the Trading Objectives in your FTMO Challenge, you will see a notification in your Account MetriX confirming that the Trading Objectives have been passed and your account is set for review, which typically takes 1-4 business days. Once your results are verified, the following steps are necessary:

You must create your FTMO Identity (KYC/KYB verification) in your Client Area.
You must proceed with the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions.

Once all necessary steps are successfully completed, we may provide you with the FTMO Account.

2-Step FTMO Challenge
FTMO Challenge

After you pass all the Trading Objectives in your FTMO Challenge, you will see a notification in your Account MetriX informing you about your success. At this point, you no longer need to trade on the account, as all Trading Objectives are marked as passed, and your account will be reviewed. The review typically takes 1-2 business days. Once results are verified, you will receive login credentials for the Verification phase.

Verification

After you successfully pass all the Trading Objectives of the Verification, you will see a notification in your Account MetriX confirming that the Trading Objectives have been passed and your account is set for review, which typically takes 1-4 business days. Once your results are verified, the following steps are necessary:

You must create your FTMO Identity (KYC/KYB verification) in your Client Area.
You must proceed with the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions.

Once all necessary steps are successfully completed, we may provide you with the FTMO Account.

Can I trade news?

FTMO restricts order execution for 2 minutes before and 2 minutes after selected news releases for all accounts, excluding the exceptions mentioned below. You are allowed to hold open positions on the targeted instruments if they were opened more than 2 minutes before the restricted event. This restriction applies to any order execution, including your Stop Loss, Take Profit or any other pending orders. Violating this rule may result in termination of an FTMO Account / FTMO Instant Account.

A restriction applies only to symbols that include the affected currency/symbol. Trading on non-targeted instruments is not restricted. For example, during the US NFP release, you may trade EURGBP or AUDNZD; however, you must not open or close trades on USDJPY or GBPUSD within the time window of 2 minutes before and 2 minutes after the NFP release.

This restriction does not apply to:

any Swing type accounts
any accounts in the FTMO Challenge or Verification phase.

With these accounts, you can trade during any news freely, provided that the Forbidden Trading Practices are avoided.

Who is an FTMO Trader, and how do I become one?
Who is an FTMO Trader, and how do I become one?
An FTMO Trader is an FTMO client who holds an FTMO Account initiated from the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge products, or holds an FTMO Instant Account, and becomes eligible for their first Reward on that particular account.
An FTMO Account is an account in which the FTMO client is eligible for a monetary Reward, provided the rules are followed. Results on an FTMO Instant Account count towards the monetary Reward from day one, provided the rules are followed.
The journey of becoming an FTMO Trader via the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge
Phase 1: FTMO Challenge

You trade on a simulated trading account and must meet all its Trading Objectives, such as the Profit Target and Consistency or Minimum Trading Days (depending on the product), without breaching your Maximum Loss Rule or Maximum Daily Loss Rule. FTMO assesses eligibility to pass the Challenge phase immediately, once you pass all Trading Objectives and close all trades. The Evaluation Process for the 1-Step FTMO Challenge ends with the FTMO Challenge phase; the Verification phase is not applicable.

Phase 2: Verification

For the 2-Step FTMO Challenge, the Verification phase represents a simplified continuation of the FTMO Challenge phase. You must pass the Verification phase to receive an FTMO Account.

Phase 3: FTMO Account

Once you pass the Evaluation Process and your results are confirmed, you will become an FTMO Trader and will receive your FTMO Account. Successful results on the FTMO Account earn monetary rewards, provided you follow the rules.

The journey of becoming an FTMO Trader via the FTMO Instant Account

FTMO Instant Account does not include the FTMO Challenge or Verification phase. However, the Trading Objectives apply. Traders must still meet the Consistency requirement without breaching their Maximum Loss Rule or Maximum Daily Loss Rule. Successful results on the FTMO Instant Account count towards the monetary Reward, provided you follow the rules. You become an FTMO Trader once your first Reward is approved.

FTMO restricts holding positions through market breaks longer than 2 hours for all accounts, excluding the exceptions mentioned below. You must close all open positions before the break begins. Violating this rule may result in termination of an FTMO Account / FTMO Instant Account.

This restriction does not apply to:

any Swing type accounts
any accounts in the FTMO Challenge or Verification

With these accounts, you can hold your trades freely over any longer market closure (e.g. the weekend), provided that the Forbidden Trading Practices are avoided.

Know the Rules. Trade with Integrity.

FTMO Futures is built for serious traders. We provide access to capital, infrastructure, and a clear path to live funding; in return, we expect trading that reflects genuine market discipline and professionalism.

The practices below are prohibited across all account stages. Our rules are designed to ensure that performance in the FTMO Futures programme reflects what a trader can actually do in live futures markets. Traders are rewarded for demonstrating real competence and consistency; not for exploiting technicalities or gaming the structure of our programme.

Violations may result in trade removal, account termination, forfeiture of rewards, or permanent restriction from the programme, depending on severity and history. If you have any doubt about whether a strategy is permitted, contact us before trading.

Prohibited Trading Practices

You must not:

1
Exploit or manipulate our Services

You must not use any trading strategy intended to exploit, game, or undermine the purpose or spirit of the programme; including strategies that take advantage of errors in our Services, delays in price updates, or any characteristic specific to a simulated environment that would not be present in a live futures market, whether or not you were aware of the exploitation.

2
Trade without independent risk management

You must not structure positions in a way that relies on the account’s drawdown protection as the sole exit mechanism, or engage in trading that would not reflect the risk management discipline expected of a professional trader operating with real capital in live market conditions.

3
Hedge or offset risk across accounts

You must not perform, alone or in concert with other persons, trades or combinations of trades designed to eliminate or reduce directional market risk. This includes simultaneously holding opposing positions across accounts held with FTMO Futures, other FTMO products, or any other operator or platform. This applies regardless of whether the instruments used are identical, related contract equivalents, or correlated products, and regardless of whether the accounts involved are held in your name or coordinated with other traders.

4
Copy trades from another trader

You must not replicate, follow, or otherwise incorporate the trading decisions of any third party into your FTMO Futures account. Whether via signal services, master accounts, trade copiers, or any manual or automated arrangement where decisions originate from someone other than the registered account holder, regardless of whether the service is paid or free, or whether the third party is also an FTMO client.

5
Use prohibited automated strategies

Automated trading is permitted. You must not, however, use software, artificial intelligence, or automated systems that manipulate, abuse, or provide an unfair advantage over the programme, including high-frequency strategies and latency arbitrage. You are fully responsible for all activity generated by your automated systems, including errors and malfunctions;

6
Trade within 2% of a CME price limit

You must not open new positions in any contract when price is within 2% of the CME-defined daily price limit for that contract and session. Price limits are recalculated daily from the prior settlement price, vary by product and time of day, and are published by CME Group

7
Hold positions or resting orders past session end

You must not carry any open position or active resting order past the end of the permitted trading session. Positions remaining open at session close are automatically liquidated by the platform. Any strategy that relies on or benefits from overnight market exposure is prohibited.

8
Trade in a manner inconsistent with live futures market standards

You must not perform trades that contradict how trading is conducted in real futures markets, or in any way that FTMO reasonably considers could cause financial, reputational, or other harm. This includes overleveraging, one-sided bets, account rolling, or any pattern of behaviour that is not reasonably replicable with real capital under real market conditions.
